property_summary: After any admissible call, c's balance will be zero when block.number is a multiple of 15 and non-zero otherwise; the bug changes the trigger block to multiples of 14, so the balance will be zero for multiples of 14 and non-zero for non-multiples of 14.
change_summary: Change the divisor in the block.number condition from 15 to 14, altering which blocks trigger the ether transfer.
